It's not systemic to the customer group but will affect any cross-border invoices where the tax code needs the VAT country to select VAT-INT.

Action plan: 
1) Short term (today) — post correcting journal entries to move the VAT amount out of suspense and into VAT-INT so the AR aging clears. See attached journal_template.xlsx with GL lines.
2) Medium term — update onboarding record and add a biweekly sweep that flags invoices with VAT-SUSP and counterparty VAT missing. I'll own the rule change and coordinate with Onboarding.
3) For audit — we'll include the remittance file and the journal posting and create a one-page confirmation for NewWave.

Lauren, please advise if you want finance to use the standard journal or route through an approval for > $50k.
